jobDescription: Our wealth management business looks after investment portfolios for about 18,000 private clients. The Compliance Operations Manager runs first-line monitoring of client onboarding and suitability files, manages a team of four compliance analysts, maintains the monitoring procedures and reports findings to the risk committee each quarter. The firm's policy for this role asks for at least eight years of compliance experience in regulated financial services, a recognised compliance qualification and previous line management of analysts. The manager reports to the head of compliance and works closely with the client onboarding team and the investment advisers.
requirements: Runs first-line monitoring of client onboarding and suitability files against a documented plan.
Has at least eight years of compliance experience in regulated financial services.
Holds a recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance.
Has line-managed compliance analysts, including objectives and performance reviews.
Reports monitoring findings to a risk committee.

evidence.text: Compliance Monitoring Lead, Brockhurst Private Wealth (February 2022 to August 2026): ran the monthly sample review of onboarding and suitability files against the monitoring plan and logged each finding with a severity rating and an owner.
Line-managed three compliance analysts from March 2024, setting their annual objectives and writing their mid-year and year-end reviews.
Presented the quarterly monitoring findings to the risk committee, including overdue remediation actions grouped by business area.
Compliance Analyst, Elmstead Asset Management (January 2019 to January 2022): checked financial promotions before release and reviewed trade surveillance alerts for the fixed-income desk.

Rewrote the suitability monitoring procedure after the consumer duty rules came in, adding outcome tests for files involving vulnerable clients and a checklist for the analysts carrying out the sample review.
Work sample: an anonymised quarterly monitoring report with the sample size per file type, findings by severity, the remediation tracker and the cover note presented to the risk committee.
Referral note forwarded by a current employee who knew the candidate at Elmstead: 'has well over ten years in compliance, going back to the bank job in Leeds before Elmstead'.

Recruiter verification: the candidate's ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance was confirmed through the International Compliance Association's award verification service, with an award date in 2021.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the monthly sample review of onboarding and suitability files against the monitoring plan, logging findings with severity and owner.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the monitoring review and the work sample shows a quarterly report built from it.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance, awarded in 2021 and confirmed with the International Compliance Association.
propositions.rationale: The recruiter verification records confirmation of the award through the awarding body.

propositions.text: The candidate has more than ten years of compliance experience in regulated financial services.
propositions.rationale: The figure comes from a referrer's second-hand remark with no dates, employer record or role for the earlier bank job; the dated roles run from January 2019 to August 2026, seven years and eight months, and the qualification rule forbids stating N years of experience that no cited source establishes.

gold.expectedGap: The dated compliance roles cover seven years and eight months, short of the eight-year requirement; the figure of over ten years comes from a referral and has no dated record.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified diploma, the dated roles and the documented monitoring, line-management and committee work; do not state more than ten years of compliance experience.
followUpTargets: Ask for the employer, dates and duties of any compliance role before January 2019, including the bank role mentioned in the referral.
validClaimSignatures: Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance
